table.name: TLGNR_MAINT_TYPE_BS
table.description: Wagon maintenance types. Following actual European guideline, e.g. G1.0, G2.0, P5 etc.

column.name: MAINT_TYPE_CD
column.description: PK Code of the reference data

column.name: IS_REPAIR_FLAG
column.description: Repair-Type Flag. In many places of the application it does not matter if a maintenance is a true (planned) maintenance, or actually an (unplanned) repair, but in some cases (transportation by the rail company) it does. Evaluation logic in tlgnc_order_rep_maint_type: If at least ONE type has IS_REPAIR_FLAG set, the whole order counts as repair.

column.name: CTL_ACT_CD
column.description: Active Flag. When new data is entered, only reference data with active flag are available for selection normally.
